name: Kay Cee Energy & Infra Ltd.
summary: Kay Cee Energy & Infra Ltd. is an India-based engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) company specializing in power transmission and distribution infrastructure. The company provides comprehensive services including the design, construction, erection, testing, and commissioning of power transmission and distribution systems, such as overhead and underground lines and substations up to 765 kV. Its service portfolio also covers the operation and maintenance of substations and Extra High Voltage (EHV) lines, including the deployment of Emergency Restoration Systems (ERS). Kay Cee Energy & Infra Ltd. primarily serves government authorities, state-owned power utilities, and private developers in India, securing projects through competitive bidding. The company focuses on critical energy infrastructure needs and aims to expand its presence across Northern and Western India, with plans to also enter the renewable energy plant construction sector, particularly for solar energy projects.
